versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.7 (software-dev-cost-dashboard)

- Added configuration and reference files: agents/openai.yaml, references/form-schema.json, references/skill.json, and scripts/run.py for enhanced structure and maintainability.
- Removed deprecated file _meta.json.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) with clearer usage instructions, supported scenarios, and detailed parameter notes.
- Clarified that all use and parameter input happens through the external web app at https://soft.ai-skills.ai; local/CLI execution is not supported.

software-dev-cost-dashboard v1.0.6

- Simplified documentation, focusing on when and how to use the skill.
- Clarified usage instructions and main scenarios.
- Updated security note: emphasizes direct browser access and external data policy.
- Removed outdated agent scripts, references, and local invocation instructions.
- Added minimal metadata file (_meta.json) for streamlined integration.

No file changes detected in version 1.0.5.

- No functional or documentation updates in this release.
- All features and usage remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Updated documentation to guide users through connecting and installing skills via the AI Skills platform, with visual step-by-step instructions.
- Clarified the intended use: only for software project cost estimation dashboards via external link, not API-executable or social/content analysis.
- Added new asset and reference files for marketplace and documentation purposes.
- Removed obsolete _meta.json.
- The skill does not support direct API or CLI execution—users must visit the provided external link.
- Security and data handling notes revised for accuracy.

software-dev-cost-dashboard v1.0.3

- Streamlined the skill package by removing unused agent and reference files.
- Added a concise meta file for basic skill metadata.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) to simplify usage instructions and clarify security, emphasizing direct external-link usage only.
- No longer supports local runner or agent-based API calls; all operations are through the external web app.

- Updated image links in the skill documentation to use cdn.aiskillsbest.com instead of local assets paths.
- No changes to functionality or APIs; documentation improvement only.
- Usage instructions, supported scenarios, and security information remain unchanged.

- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md, including detailed usage guidance, invocation clarifications, and best practice instructions for AI Skills integration.
- Updated skill description to clarify proper and improper usage scenarios.
- Added five new files: agents/openai.yaml, references/form-schema.json, references/marketplace-assets.json, references/skill.json, and scripts/run.py.
- Clarified that this skill uses "external-link" mode—no API or agent execution is performed locally.
- Provided example output and external link handling instructions for users.

software-dev-cost-dashboard v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides an external dashboard for software development cost estimation.
- Guides users to input project details for budget, quotation, and effort estimation.
- Offers use cases such as project budgeting, resource planning, and cost comparison.
- Includes a clear workflow and instructions for report export.
- Data is entered directly on the external site; data security depends on the target platform.
